en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large wooden villa or manor house with a two‑story columned veranda and decorative railings. A flagpole on the roof flies a Scandinavian-style Nordic cross flag that appears to be the Swedish flag. Leafless trees stand in the foreground, suggesting late autumn or winter. Printed text in the upper right corner reads "Prästgården i Sköldinge".
